name: Schwerin Residence Ensemble
description: Schwerin, in northeast Germany, spreads along the shores of Lake Schwerin, with a fairy-tale palace on its own island at the centre. Mostly built in the 19th century for the Grand Dukes of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, the 38 listed elements include the golden-domed residence, manor houses, churches, parks and the Pfaffenteich ornamental lake. Together they show off a lively mix of Neo-Classical, Neo-Baroque and Neo-Renaissance styles.
